import json
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.lines import Line2D

with open('/app/benchmark/task_input.json') as f:
    task = json.load(f)
with open('/app/benchmark/source_data.json') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

goal = task.get('goal', [''])[0]
style = task.get('style', '').lower()

sst = data['sea_surface_temperature_anomaly']['data']
ph = data['ocean_ph']['data']
coral = data['coral_cover']['data']
plastic = data['ocean_plastic_pollution']['data']

years = [d['year'] for d in sst]
sst_vals = [d['anomaly_c'] for d in sst]
ph_vals = [d['ph'] for d in ph]
coral_vals = [d['cover_pct'] for d in coral]
plastic_vals = [d['plastic_mmt'] for d in plastic]

plt.style.use('seaborn-v0_8-whitegrid')
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(12.5, 7.5), dpi=180)

# Professional, accessible palette
colors = {
    'sst':'#D55E00',      # warm red-orange
    'ph':'#0072B2',       # blue
    'coral':'#009E73',    # green
    'plastic':'#7B61A8'   # purple
}

# Normalize to index (1990 = 100) for comparable multi-unit trend storytelling
base = {
    'sst': sst_vals[0],
    'ph': ph_vals[0],
    'coral': coral_vals[0],
    'plastic': plastic_vals[0],
}
idx_sst = [v/base['sst']*100 for v in sst_vals]
idx_ph = [v/base['ph']*100 for v in ph_vals]
idx_coral = [v/base['coral']*100 for v in coral_vals]
idx_plastic = [v/base['plastic']*100 for v in plastic_vals]

ax.plot(years, idx_sst, color=colors['sst'], lw=2.8, label='Sea surface temperature anomaly (°C)')
ax.plot(years, idx_ph, color=colors['ph'], lw=2.8, label='Ocean pH')
ax.plot(years, idx_coral, color=colors['coral'], lw=2.8, label='Coral cover (%)')
ax.plot(years, idx_plastic, color=colors['plastic'], lw=3.0, label='Ocean plastic pollution (million metric tons)')

# Baseline and key markers
ax.axhline(100, color='#666666', lw=1.2, ls='--', alpha=0.7)
ax.annotate('1990 baseline = 100', xy=(1991, 101.5), color='#555555', fontsize=10)

# End labels
series = [
    ('SST anomaly', idx_sst[-1], colors['sst']),
    ('Ocean pH', idx_ph[-1], colors['ph']),
    ('Coral cover', idx_coral[-1], colors['coral']),
    ('Plastic pollution', idx_plastic[-1], colors['plastic'])
]
for name, yv, c in series:
    ax.scatter(years[-1], yv, color=c, s=28, zorder=5)

ax.set_title('Ocean Health Indicators Diverge Sharply Since 1990', fontsize=18, weight='bold', pad=14)
ax.set_xlabel('Year', fontsize=12)
ax.set_ylabel('Index (1990 = 100, unitless)', fontsize=12)
ax.set_xlim(min(years)-0.5, max(years)+1.2)
ax.set_ylim(35, max(idx_plastic)*1.08)

ax.set_xticks([1990,1995,2000,2005,2010,2015,2020,2024])

legend = ax.legend(
    loc='upper left',
    frameon=True,
    title='Indicators (original units shown in legend)',
    fontsize=10,
    title_fontsize=10
)
legend.get_frame().set_alpha(0.95)

# Insight callout from goal context
ax.text(
    0.99, 0.02,
    f'Goal: {goal}',
    transform=ax.transAxes,
    ha='right', va='bottom', fontsize=9, color='#444444'
)

for spine in ['top', 'right']:
    ax.spines[spine].set_visible(False)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('/app/output/result.png', bbox_inches='tight')
PY
